import { goldenCrafterChoices } from './golden-crafter-rules.js';
import { createCharacterStatsPanel } from './character-stats-panel.js';
import { createBitmapText } from './bitmap-font.js';
import { crafterChoices } from './crafter-rules.js';
import { getLootTotals } from './exp-drops.js';
import { rollLevelUpgrades } from './level-upgrades.js';

/** Crop/rotate the actual inventory icon, matching the HUD rather than stretching a sheet. */
function inventoryIcon(target) {
  const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=canvas.height=128;
  canvas.className='crafter-inventory-icon';canvas.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  if(!target?.icon)return canvas;
  const image=new Image();
  image.onload=()=>{
    const crop=target.iconCrop||{x:0,y:0,width:image.naturalWidth,height:image.naturalHeight};
    const angle=(target.iconRotation||0)*Math.PI/180;
    const width=Math.abs(crop.width*Math.cos(angle))+Math.abs(crop.height*Math.sin(angle));
    const height=Math.abs(crop.width*Math.sin(angle))+Math.abs(crop.height*Math.cos(angle));
    const scale=116/Math.max(width,height),context=canvas.getContext('2d');
    context.save();context.translate(64,64);context.rotate(angle);
    context.drawImage(image,crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height,-crop.width*scale/2,-crop.height*scale/2,crop.width*scale,crop.height*scale);context.restore();
  };
  image.src=target.icon;return canvas;
}

/** Two-row inventory selector, character stats and the currently selected upgrade preview. */
export function createCrafterMenu({canvas,getPlayer,onCancel,onAction,golden=false}) {
  const dialog=document.createElement('dialog');dialog.id=golden?'golden-crafter-menu':'crafter-menu';dialog.className=golden?'crafter-menu golden-crafter-menu':'crafter-menu';
  dialog.setAttribute('aria-labelledby',golden?'golden-crafter-title':'crafter-title');
  const layout=document.createElement('div');layout.className='crafter-layout';
  const stats=document.createElement('aside');stats.className='crafter-character pause-character-stats';stats.setAttribute('aria-label','Character stats');
  const work=document.createElement('section');work.className='crafter-workspace';
  const title=document.createElement('h2');title.id=golden?'golden-crafter-title':'crafter-title';
  const balance=document.createElement('p');balance.className='crafter-balance';
  const weapons=document.createElement('div'),equipment=document.createElement('div');
  for(const [row,label] of [[weapons,'Weapons'],[equipment,'Equipment']]){row.className='crafter-slot-grid';row.setAttribute('role','group');row.setAttribute('aria-label',label);}
  const detail=document.createElement('section');detail.className='crafter-upgrade-detail';detail.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');
  const modes=document.createElement('div');modes.className='crafter-action-modes';
  const footer=document.createElement('footer');footer.className='crafter-footer';
  const confirm=document.createElement('button');confirm.type='button';confirm.id=golden?'golden-crafter-confirm':'crafter-confirm';confirm.className='crafter-confirm';
  const cancel=document.createElement('button');cancel.type='button';cancel.className='crafter-cancel';
  const help=document.createElement('p');help.className='crafter-key-help';
  footer.append(modes,confirm,cancel);work.append(title,balance,weapons,equipment,detail,footer,help);layout.append(stats,work);dialog.append(layout);document.body.append(dialog);
  let selected=0,actionId=null,slotButtons=[],currentChoice=null,viewScale=1;
  /** Use the supplied game font while retaining accessible button text. */
  function text(element,value,scale=1.3) {
    element.setAttribute('aria-label',value);element.replaceChildren();
    const graphic=document.createElement('canvas');graphic.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    element.append(graphic);createBitmapText(graphic,{variant:'font2',scale:scale*viewScale,wrap:false}).setText(value);
  }
  /** Keep the modal exactly over the simulated game viewport, including fullscreen changes. */
  function align() {
    const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect?.();if(!rect)return;
    const previousScale=viewScale;viewScale=Math.min(1,rect.width/1280);
    dialog.style.left=`${rect.left}px`;dialog.style.top=`${rect.top}px`;
    dialog.style.width=`${rect.width}px`;dialog.style.height=`${rect.height}px`;
    if(dialog.open&&Math.abs(previousScale-viewScale)>.001)render();
  }
  if(typeof ResizeObserver!=='undefined')new ResizeObserver(align).observe(canvas);
  if(typeof window!=='undefined'){window.addEventListener('resize',align);window.addEventListener('scroll',align,true);}
  /** Show the same six core stats used in the pause menu with a holographic portrait. */
  function renderStats(player) {
    createCharacterStatsPanel({root:stats,scale:viewScale}).update(player);
  }

  function targetAt(index) {return index<6?getPlayer().attackSlots?.[index]:getPlayer().equipmentSlots?.[index-6];}
  /** Selecting a slot changes only the preview; Confirm performs the one-use transaction. */
  function select(index,focus=false,resetAction=true) {
    selected=index;if(resetAction)actionId=null;
    slotButtons.forEach((button,i)=>{button.classList.toggle('selected',i===selected);button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(i===selected));button.tabIndex=i===selected?0:-1;});
    renderDetail();if(focus)slotButtons[selected]?.focus({preventScroll:true});
  }
  function renderDetail() {
    const player=getPlayer(),target=targetAt(selected),prefix=`${selected<6?'weapon':'item'}:${selected%6}:`;
    const available=golden?goldenCrafterChoices(player).filter(choice=>choice.slots.includes(selected)):crafterChoices(player).filter(choice=>choice.id.startsWith(prefix));
    currentChoice=available.find(choice=>choice.id===actionId)||available[0]||null;
    actionId=currentChoice?.id||null;
    slotButtons.forEach((button,index)=>button.classList.toggle('fusion-partner',Boolean(golden&&currentChoice?.slots.includes(index)&&index!==selected)));
    detail.replaceChildren();modes.replaceChildren();
    const heading=document.createElement('div');heading.className='crafter-detail-heading';
    const name=document.createElement('h3'),category=document.createElement('span');
    const displayTarget=golden&&currentChoice?currentChoice.target:target;
    text(name,golden&&currentChoice?currentChoice.name:target?`${target.name||target.id||'Equipment'} LV ${target.level||1}${target.enhancementRank?` +${target.enhancementRank}`:''}`:'Empty slot',1.4);
    text(category,golden?'>> Synergy':selected<6?'>> Weapon':'>> Equipment',1.05);heading.append(name,category);
    const body=document.createElement('div');body.className='crafter-detail-body';
    const icon=inventoryIcon(displayTarget),description=document.createElement('div');
    let info='Select an equipped weapon or item.';
    if(target&&!currentChoice)info=golden?'No compatible MAX-level weapon pair.':'Maximum level reached. No upgrade is available.';
    if(currentChoice) {
      if(golden)info=currentChoice.description;
      else if(currentChoice.id.endsWith(':level'))info=rollLevelUpgrades(player).find(choice=>choice.weapon===target)?.description||`Upgrade to LV ${(target.level||1)+1}.`;
      else if(currentChoice.id.endsWith(':awaken'))info='Awaken the main weapon. Requires 1 Secret Tech Note.';
      else info=`Add 2 base damage per enhancement rank, split across primary projectiles. ${currentChoice.cost} Credits. ${Math.round(currentChoice.chance*100)}% success.`;
    }
    // Wrap long explanations using the bitmap renderer instead of browser fonts.
    const graphic=document.createElement('canvas');description.setAttribute('aria-label',info);description.append(graphic);
    createBitmapText(graphic,{variant:'font2',scale:1.2*viewScale,wrap:true,maxWidth:600*viewScale}).setText(info);
    body.append(icon,description);detail.append(heading,body);
    for(const choice of available) {
      if(available.length<2)break;
      const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.className='crafter-mode';
      button.classList.toggle('selected',choice.id===actionId);text(button,golden?choice.name:choice.id.endsWith(':awaken')?'Awaken':'Enhance',1.1);
      button.addEventListener('click',()=>{actionId=choice.id;renderDetail();});modes.append(button);
    }
    confirm.disabled=!currentChoice||currentChoice.disabled;
    text(confirm,currentChoice?.label||'Unavailable',1.1);
    const loot=getLootTotals();text(balance,`Credits: ${loot.credits}   Secret Tech Notes: ${loot.secretTechNotes}`,1.05);
  }
  function render() {
    const player=getPlayer();renderStats(player);slotButtons=[];weapons.replaceChildren();equipment.replaceChildren();
    text(title,golden?'GOLDEN CRAFTER':'UPGRADE!',golden?2:2.8);text(cancel,'Cancel',1.2);text(help,'CONFIRM: SPACE / ENTER   |   CANCEL: SHIFT / ESC',.9);
    for(let index=0;index<12;index++) {
      const target=targetAt(index),button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.className='crafter-slot';
      button.disabled=!target||(golden&&index>=6);button.setAttribute('aria-label',target?`${target.name||target.id}, LV ${target.level||1}`:`Empty ${index<6?'weapon':'equipment'} slot ${index%6+1}`);
      button.append(inventoryIcon(target));
      if(target?.level){const level=document.createElement('span');level.className='crafter-slot-level';text(level,`LV ${target.level}${target.enhancementRank?` +${target.enhancementRank}`:''}`,.8);button.append(level);}
      button.addEventListener('click',()=>select(index));slotButtons.push(button);(index<6?weapons:equipment).append(button);
    }
    if(!targetAt(selected)||slotButtons[selected]?.disabled)selected=slotButtons.findIndex(button=>!button.disabled);
    select(Math.max(0,selected),false,false);
  }
  confirm.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(currentChoice&&!currentChoice.disabled)onAction(currentChoice.id);});
  cancel.addEventListener('click',onCancel);
  dialog.addEventListener('cancel',event=>{event.preventDefault();onCancel();});
  dialog.addEventListener('contextmenu',event=>{event.preventDefault();onCancel();});
  dialog.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{
    if(event.key==='Shift'&&!event.repeat){event.preventDefault();onCancel();return;}
    const step={ArrowLeft:-1,ArrowRight:1,ArrowUp:-6,ArrowDown:6}[event.key];
    if(step){event.preventDefault();for(let n=1;n<=12;n++){const index=(selected+step*n+144)%12;if(targetAt(index)&&!slotButtons[index].disabled){select(index,true);break;}}}
    if((event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' ')&&!event.repeat&&!event.target.classList?.contains('crafter-mode')&&event.target!==cancel){event.preventDefault();if(currentChoice&&!currentChoice.disabled)onAction(currentChoice.id);}
  });
  return {open(){selected=golden?goldenCrafterChoices(getPlayer())[0]?.slots[0]??0:0;actionId=null;align();dialog.showModal();render();(slotButtons.find(button=>!button.disabled)||cancel).focus();},
    refresh:render,close(){dialog.close();},get element(){return dialog;}};
}
assert.equal(actions.length,0); // Selecting is never a purchase.
const confirm=nodes.find(n=>n.id==='crafter-confirm');confirm.listeners.click();assert.equal(actions.at(-1),'weapon:0:level');
grids[1].children[0].listeners.click();assert.equal(actions.length,1);confirm.listeners.click();assert.equal(actions.at(-1),'item:0:level');
grids[0].children[1].listeners.click();confirm.listeners.click();assert.equal(actions.at(-1),'weapon:1:enhance');
assert(grids[0].children.slice(2).every(n=>n.disabled));
const dialog=nodes.find(n=>n.tag==='dialog');assert.equal(dialog.style.width,'1280px');assert.equal(dialog.style.left,'100px');
dialog.listeners.keydown({key:'ArrowLeft',target:dialog,preventDefault(){}});confirm.listeners.click();assert.equal(actions.at(-1),'weapon:0:level');
dialog.listeners.cancel({preventDefault(){}});assert.equal(cancelled,1);
assert(nodes.some(n=>n.renderedText==='UPGRADE!'));
console.log('PASS: six weapon/six equipment slots, selection before purchase, matching details/action, keyboard navigation, viewport alignment and cancellation.');

assert(nodes.some(n=>n.className==='pause-hologram'));
assert(nodes.some(n=>n.className==='pause-stat-content'));
assert.equal(nodes.filter(n=>n.className==='pause-stat-row').length,6);
assert(nodes.some(n=>n.renderedText==='0%')); // CRT follows Pause formatting without an added plus sign.

vm.runInContext('var goldMenu=createCrafterMenu({canvas,getPlayer,onCancel,onAction,golden:true});goldMenu.open()',c);
const goldConfirm=nodes.find(n=>n.id==='golden-crafter-confirm');assert(goldConfirm.disabled);
assert(nodes.some(n=>n.renderedText==='GOLDEN CRAFTER'));

import { umbrellaUpgradeSettings, arisWeaponSettings, levelUpgradeSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { ensurePlayerStats } from './player-stats.js';
import { createArisWeapon, getArisWeapon } from './aris-weapon.js';
import { getUmbrella } from './weapon-progression.js';

const descriptions = {
  2: 'Increase damage by 30%.',
  3: 'Increase attack area by 20%.',
  4: 'Reduce time between attacks by 10%.',
  5: 'Increase damage by 30%.',
  6: 'Increase attack area by 20%.',
  7: 'Critical hits are guaranteed and deal 3x damage.'
};

/** Offer only the next upgrade for an equipped, implemented weapon. */
function umbrellaChoices(player) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  const weapon = getUmbrella(player);
  if (!weapon) return [];
  const level = weapon.level || 1;
  if (level < umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel) return [{ id: 'umbrella-level',
    name: `Plana's Umbrella LV ${level + 1}`, weapon, category: 'Weapon', description: descriptions[level + 1] }];
  return [];
}

const arisDescriptions = {
  2: 'Increase beam size by 30%.',
  3: 'Reduce attack cooldown by 0.5 seconds.',
  4: 'Increase damage by 50%.',
  5: 'Reduce attack cooldown by 0.5 seconds.',
  6: 'Increase beam size by 50%.',
  7: 'Fire an additional beam from behind.'
};

/** Offer acquisition or the next Aris upgrade, plus existing umbrella choices. */
export function rollLevelUpgrades(player) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  const choices = umbrellaChoices(player);
  const weapon = getArisWeapon(player);
  if (!weapon && (player.attackSlots || []).filter(Boolean).length < 6) choices.push({
    id: 'aris-new', name: "Supernova LV 1", weapon: createArisWeapon(), category: 'NEW Weapon',
    description: 'Shoot a powerful piercing laser beam every 3 seconds.'
  });
  else if (weapon && (weapon.level || 1) < arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel) choices.push({
    id: 'aris-level', name: `Supernova LV ${(weapon.level || 1) + 1}`, weapon, category: 'Weapon',
    description: arisDescriptions[(weapon.level || 1) + 1]
  });
  return choices.slice(0, levelUpgradeSettings.choices);
}

/** Advance one weapon level; awakening is available only through a Crafter. */
export function applyLevelUpgrade(player, id) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  if (player.pendingUpgrades <= 0 || !rollLevelUpgrades(player).some(choice => choice.id === id)) return false;
  const weapon = id.startsWith('aris-') ? getArisWeapon(player) : getUmbrella(player);
  if (id === 'aris-new') {
    player.attackSlots ??= [];
    const empty = player.attackSlots.findIndex(item => !item);
    if (empty >= 0) player.attackSlots[empty] = createArisWeapon();
    else player.attackSlots.push(createArisWeapon());
  } else if (id === 'aris-level') weapon.level = Math.min(arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else if (id === 'umbrella-level') weapon.level = Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else return false;
  player.pendingUpgrades--;
  return true;
}

import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Stun independently of displacement, respecting knockback resistance and absolute immunity. */
export function applySkillControl(enemy, dx, dy, stunSeconds, travelSeconds, options = {}) {
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining || 0, stunSeconds);
  enemy.skillKnockback = beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, travelSeconds, options);
  enemy.contactReaction = null; enemy.attack = null; enemy.moving = false;
}

/** Resolve stun before AI/contact so a stunned enemy cannot move or damage the player. */
export function updateEnemyControl(enemy, delta, move) {
  const stunned = enemy.stunRemaining > 0;
  if (!stunned && !enemy.skillKnockback) return false;
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(0, (enemy.stunRemaining || 0) - delta);
  if (enemy.stunRemaining < 1e-6) enemy.stunRemaining = 0;
  const knockback = enemy.skillKnockback;
  if (knockback) {
    if (!advanceKnockback(enemy, knockback, delta, move)) delete enemy.skillKnockback;
  }
  if (stunned) enemy.moving = false;
  return stunned;
}

/** Match handwritten 1Ã¢â‚¬â€œ6 locally, without downloading or calling either AI model. */
export function recognizeAdminDigit(strokes) {
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return null;
  const width = bounds.right - bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
  if (height > 0 && width / height < .18) return 1;
  const ranked = Object.entries(adminDigitTemplates).map(([digit, template]) =>
    ({ digit: Number(digit), score: drawingAccuracy(strokes, template) })).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  return ranked[0].score >= .45 && ranked[0].score - ranked[1].score >= .025 ? ranked[0].digit : null;
}

/** Explicitly clear the test population without affecting player state. */
export function clearEnemies() {
  enemies.clear();
}

/** Add or update an enemy's state without tying its lifetime to camera visibility. */
export function rememberEnemy(id, state) {
  const existed = enemies.has(id);
  const enemy = { ...enemies.get(id), ...state, id };
  const saved = savedEnemyHealth.get(enemies.get(id));
  if (saved) savedEnemyHealth.set(enemy, saved);
  applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy);
  enemies.set(id, enemy);
  if (!existed) for (const listener of spawnListeners) listener(enemy);
  return enemy;
}

/** Read a remembered enemy even after its background tile has left the screen. */
export function getEnemy(id) {
  return enemies.get(id);
}

/** Apply damage and trigger a brief sprite pulse; remove defeated test enemies. */
export function damageEnemy(id, amount, source, hitType = 'normal', options = {}) {
  const enemy = enemies.get(id);
  if (!enemy || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  if (options.instantKO && (isBossEnemy(enemy) || enemy.miniBoss || enemy.instantKOImmune)) return false;
  if (options.canMiss && midoriDodges(enemy, source)) {
    showDamageNumber(enemy, 0, false, 'miss');
    return false;
  }
  const harmless = ['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type);
  if (harmless) {
    dropYuukaCredits(enemy); // Each accepted hit, including the final hit.
    enemy.receivedHits = (enemy.receivedHits || 0) + 1;
  }
  const requiredHits = harmless ? (enemy.hitsToDefeat ?? harmlessEnemySettings[`${enemy.type}HitsToDefeat`]) : null;
  enemy.hp = Math.max(0, enemy.hp - amount);
  // Count accepted hits, not damage points; misses and rejected hits never reach this branch.
  if (Number.isFinite(requiredHits) && requiredHits >= 1 && enemy.receivedHits >= requiredHits) enemy.hp = 0;
  showDamageNumber(enemy, amount, false, hitType); // Include overkill and crit styling.
  enemy.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
  if (enemy.hp === 0) {
    const bossesAliveBefore = [...enemies.values()].filter(isBossEnemy).length;
    killCount++;
    dropEnemyExp(enemy);
    dropEnemyLoot(enemy);
    beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source);
    enemies.delete(id);
    for (const listener of defeatListeners) listener({ enemy, bossesAliveBefore });
  }
  return enemy;
}

/** End only this event's enemies with visual deaths, without loot, kills or boss charge. */
export function endEventEnemies(eventKey, source) {
  if (!eventKey) return 0;
  let removed = 0;
  for (const [id, enemy] of enemies) {
    if (enemy.eventKey !== eventKey || isBossEnemy(enemy)) continue;
    beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source, { knockback: false });
    enemies.delete(id);
    removed++;
import { segmentPlanaPattern } from './plana-pattern.js';
import { drawingModelImage, drawingBounds, normalizeSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { drawingAccuracy, skillDamageMultiplier } from './skill-accuracy.js';
import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Require interior ink in both symbol regions before allowing CLIP to rescue rough geometry. */
function hasBothSymbols(strokes) {
  const b = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!b) return false;
  const cx = (b.left + b.right) / 2, cy = (b.top + b.bottom) / 2;
  const w = b.right - b.left, h = b.bottom - b.top;
  if (!(w > 0) || !(h > 0)) return false;
  const inner = strokes.flat().filter(p => Math.hypot((p.x-cx)/(w/2), (p.y-cy)/(h/2)) < .76);
  return inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x > cx+w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x > cx+w*.04);
}

/** Combine full-symbol CLIP, isolated QuickDraw parts and forgiving spatial validation. */
export async function recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  if (weapon?.id === 'aris-laser') return recognizeSupernovaPattern(strokes, recognizer, isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id !== 'plana-umbrella') return { valid: false, reason: 'No drawing skill is defined for this weapon yet.' };
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const pattern = segmentPlanaPattern(strokes);
  const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes);
  let clipPredictions = [], clipError;
  try {
    if (recognizer.recognizeSymbol) clipPredictions = await recognizer.recognizeSymbol(drawingModelImage(strokes));
  } catch (error) {
    // Download/inference failure must not disable an otherwise recognized geometric cast.
    clipError = error.message;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  const clipMatch = clipPredictions[0]?.label === 'a hand drawn circle enclosing an arrow above an X cross' &&
    clipPredictions[0].score >= skillCastSettings.clipMinimumScore;
  const rescued = clipMatch && accuracy >= skillCastSettings.referenceMinimum && hasBothSymbols(strokes);
  if (!pattern.valid && !rescued) return { ...pattern, clipPredictions, accuracy };
  const components = [];
  // When geometry cannot reliably split rough ink, ask QuickDraw about the whole sketch.
  const parts = pattern.valid ? pattern.parts : [{ name: 'whole pattern', strokes }];
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    try {
      const predictions = await recognizer.recognize(drawingModelImage(part.strokes));
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions });
    } catch (error) {
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions: [], error: error.message });
    }
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  return { valid: true, skillId: 'plana-umbrella-launch', label: 'Plana: Umbrella Launch',
    score: pattern.valid ? pattern.score : clipPredictions[0].score,
    accuracy, damageMultiplier: skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy), components, clipPredictions, clipError };
}


/** Let the drawing identify a ready EX skill; autoattacks never require weapon selection. */
export async function recognizeLoadoutPattern(strokes, skills, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  let bestMatch = null, bestFailure = null;
  const validMatches = [];
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    const result = await recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent);
    const accuracy = weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes, supernovaReferenceStrokes()) :
      weapon.id === 'plana-umbrella' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes) : 0;
    const candidate = {...result, weapon, matchAccuracy: accuracy};
    if (result.valid) validMatches.push(candidate);
    if (result.valid && (!bestMatch || accuracy > bestMatch.matchAccuracy)) bestMatch = candidate;
    if (!bestFailure || accuracy > bestFailure.matchAccuracy) bestFailure = candidate;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  validMatches.sort((a,b)=>b.matchAccuracy-a.matchAccuracy);
  if (validMatches.length > 1 && validMatches[0].matchAccuracy-validMatches[1].matchAccuracy < skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin) {
    return {valid:false,reason:'Drawing is ambiguous. Please try again.'};
  }
  return bestMatch || bestFailure || {valid:false,reason:'No ready skill matches this pattern.'};
}


/** Three crown spikes with open underside; a diamond sits above the crown. */
export function supernovaReferenceStrokes() {
  const path = points => points.map(([x,y]) => ({x,y}));
  return [path([[45,165],[35,110],[67.5,142],[100,110],[132.5,142],[165,110],[155,165]]),
    path([[100,25],[126,60],[100,95],[74,60],[100,25]])];
}

/** Geometric whole-symbol matching plus isolated QuickDraw assistance, with offline fallback. */
export async function recognizeSupernovaPattern(strokes, recognizer, isCurrent) {
  const normalized = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds = drawingBounds(normalized);
  if (!bounds) return {valid:false,reason:'Draw the Supernova pattern.'};
  const width = bounds.right-bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom-bounds.top;
  const split = bounds.top + height*.53;
  const upper = normalized.map(stroke=>stroke.filter(p=>p.y<split)).filter(s=>s.length);
  const lower = normalized.map(stroke=>stroke.filter(p=>p.y>=split)).filter(s=>s.length);
  const diamondBounds=drawingBounds(upper), crownBounds=drawingBounds(lower);
  // The narrow diamond sits above the wider crown; reject enclosing circles/partial symbols.
  if (!diamondBounds || !crownBounds || diamondBounds.right-diamondBounds.left>width*.75 ||
      crownBounds.right-crownBounds.left<width*.75 || diamondBounds.bottom-diamondBounds.top<height*.25) {
    return {valid:false,reason:'Draw a diamond above an open-bottom three-spike crown.'};
  }
  const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes,supernovaReferenceStrokes());
  if (accuracy < .62) return {valid:false, reason:'Draw an open-bottom three-spike crown and a diamond.'};
  const components = [];
  for (const stroke of normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes)) {
    if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
    try { components.push({name:'Supernova component',predictions:await recognizer.recognize(drawingModelImage([stroke]))}); }
    catch { /* Local reference remains available when model inference is offline. */ }
  }
  return {valid:true,skillId:'supernova-beam',label:'Supernova',score:accuracy,accuracy,
    damageMultiplier:skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy),components};
}

import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** List equipped weapon skills and an optional future ultimate, each with its own timer. */
export function equippedSkills(character) {
  return [...(character.attackSlots || []), character.ultimateSkill].filter(skill => skill?.icon && skill.exSkill !== false);
}

/** Find availability only; this does not select or equip a weapon. */
export function readySkill(character) {
  return equippedSkills(character).find(skill => !(skill.skillCooldownRemaining > 0));
}

/** Put a cooldown on the exact weapon that initiated a cast, independently of other weapons. */
export function setSkillCooldown(weapon, seconds) {
  weapon.skillCooldownDuration = seconds;
  weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = seconds;
}

/** Tick each equipped weapon once; global pause freezes these timers in the game loop. */
export function advanceSkillCooldowns(characters, delta) {
  const visited = new Set();
  for (const character of characters) for (const weapon of equippedSkills(character)) {
    if (!weapon || visited.has(weapon)) continue;
    visited.add(weapon);
    weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = Math.max(0, (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining || 0) - Math.max(0, delta));

/** Let the drawing identify a ready EX skill; autoattacks never require weapon selection. */
export async function recognizeLoadoutPattern(strokes, skills, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  let bestMatch = null, bestFailure = null;
  const validMatches = [];
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    const result = await recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent);
    const accuracy = weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes, supernovaReferenceStrokes()) :
      weapon.id === 'plana-umbrella' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes) : 0;
    const candidate = {...result, weapon, matchAccuracy: accuracy};
    if (result.valid) validMatches.push(candidate);
    if (result.valid && (!bestMatch || accuracy > bestMatch.matchAccuracy)) bestMatch = candidate;
    if (!bestFailure || accuracy > bestFailure.matchAccuracy) bestFailure = candidate;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  validMatches.sort((a,b)=>b.matchAccuracy-a.matchAccuracy);
  if (validMatches.length > 1 && validMatches[0].matchAccuracy-validMatches[1].matchAccuracy < skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin) {
    return {valid:false,reason:'Drawing is ambiguous. Please try again.'};
  }
  return bestMatch || bestFailure || {valid:false,reason:'No ready skill matches this pattern.'};
}

  }
  return {valid:true,skillId:'supernova-beam',label:'Supernova',score:accuracy,accuracy,
    damageMultiplier:skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy),components};
}


/** Choose a cancellation target locally; empty/unrelated ink never selects a default slot. */
export function closestDrawingSkill(strokes, skills) {
  if (!drawingBounds(strokes)) return null;
  let best = null, score = .25, runnerUp = 0;
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    const reference = weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? supernovaReferenceStrokes() : undefined;
    if (!reference && weapon.id !== 'plana-umbrella') continue;
    const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes, reference);
    if (accuracy > score) { runnerUp = score === .25 ? 0 : score; score = accuracy; best = weapon; }
    else runnerUp = Math.max(runnerUp,accuracy);
  }
  return score-runnerUp >= skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin ? best : null;
}

/** Equip Kei's automatic weapon; its EX skill has not been defined yet. */
export function createLuminousNovaWeapon() {
  return {id:'luminous-nova',name:'Luminous Nova',level:1,maxLevel:luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel,

export function getLuminousNova(player) {return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon=>weapon?.id==='luminous-nova');}

/** Fire-rate bonuses are absolute multiples of the base cycle, never cumulative multipliers. */
export function luminousNovaLevelStats(player) {
  const level=Math.max(1,Math.min(7,getLuminousNova(player)?.level||1));
  const fireRate=1+Number(level>=3)+Number(level>=5)+Number(level>=7);
  return {level,fireRate,interval:luminousNovaSettings.attackInterval/fireRate,
    damageMultiplier:(level>=2?1.2:1)*(level>=4?1.3:1),knockback:level>=6};
}

/** Damage levels multiply base damage; flat enhancements split over the base-cycle projectile count. */
export function rollLuminousNovaDamage(player,random=Math.random,target) {
  const stats=luminousNovaLevelStats(player);
  return rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'luminous-nova',luminousNovaSettings.damageMultiplier,
    [(stats.damageMultiplier-1)*100],{projectileCount:stats.fireRate,hitCooldownFrames:10}),random,{target});
}

/** Sweep the spherical head so fast plasma rounds cannot tunnel past enemies. */
export function luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,to,radius=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter/2) {
  const body=getCombatHitbox(enemy,true);
  return segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+radius,ry:body.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,to.x,to.y);
}

/** Map successful reference accuracy to minimum/typical/perfect damage anchors. */
export function skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy) {
  const s = skillCastSettings;
  const value = Number.isFinite(accuracy) ? accuracy : s.accuracyAverage;
  const low = value <= s.accuracyAverage;
  const start = low ? s.accuracyMinimum : s.accuracyAverage;
  const end = low ? s.accuracyAverage : s.accuracyPerfect;
  const from = low ? s.damageMinimum : s.damageAverage;
  const to = low ? s.damageAverage : s.damageMaximum;
  return from + (to - from) * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (value - start) / (end - start)));
}

/** Boss identity is explicit, never inferred from an elite's enlarged sprite. */
export function isBossEnemy(enemy) {
  if(enemy.boss === false) return false;
  return enemy.boss === true || enemy.type === 'iroha' || enemy.type === 'shiroko';
}

/** Render special enemies above normal actors, while bosses always own the final layer. */
export function enemyRenderLayer(enemy) {
  if (isBossEnemy(enemy)) return 'boss';
  return enemy.special === true || enemy.type === 'yuuka' ? 'special' : 'normal';
}

/** Measure distance from sprite edges to the gameplay viewport rectangle. */
export function enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height) {
  const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2;
  const dx = Math.max(camera.x - (enemy.x + radius), enemy.x - radius - camera.x - width, 0);
  const dy = Math.max(camera.y - (enemy.y + radius), enemy.y - radius - camera.y - height, 0);
  return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
}

/** Uniformly sample ink length, ignoring pen speed, stroke order and direction. */
function normalizedInk(strokes) {
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return [];
  const size = Math.max(bounds.right - bounds.left, bounds.bottom - bounds.top, 1);
  const points = [];
  for (const stroke of strokes) for (let i = 1; i < stroke.length; i++) {
    const a = stroke[i - 1], b = stroke[i];
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) / size * 180));
    for (let j = 0; j <= count; j++) points.push({
      x: (a.x + (b.x - a.x) * j / count - (bounds.left + bounds.right) / 2) / size,
      y: (a.y + (b.y - a.y) * j / count - (bounds.top + bounds.bottom) / 2) / size
    });
  }
  // Bound comparison work even for very long mouse strokes.
  const unique = [...new Map(points.map(p => [
    `${Math.round(p.x * 10000)},${Math.round(p.y * 10000)}`, p
  ])).values()].sort((a, b) => Math.round(a.x * 10000) - Math.round(b.x * 10000) ||
    Math.round(a.y * 10000) - Math.round(b.y * 10000));
  return unique.filter((_, i) => i % Math.max(1, Math.ceil(unique.length / 320)) === 0);
}

/** Symmetric ink distance rewards the entire reference, including missing/extra marks. */
export function drawingAccuracy(strokes, referenceStrokes = planaReferenceStrokes()) {
  const actual = normalizedInk(strokes), reference = normalizedInk(referenceStrokes);
  if (!actual.length) return 0;
  const nearestMean = (from, to) => from.reduce((total, p) => total +
    Math.min(...to.map(q => Math.hypot(p.x - q.x, p.y - q.y))), 0) / from.length;
  const error = (nearestMean(actual, reference) + nearestMean(reference, actual)) / 2;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - error / skillCastSettings.accuracyDistanceTolerance));
}

/** Shared spherical plasma rendering; the EX changes diameter without changing the normal weapon. */
export function drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,diameter=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter,duration=luminousNovaSettings.duration) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings,radius=diameter/2;
      context.save();context.translate(bullet.x-camera.x,bullet.y-camera.y);context.rotate(bullet.angle);
      context.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,(duration-bullet.age)/.06);
      context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
      const halo=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,radius*.2,0,0,radius*1.7);
      halo.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,155,235,.55)');halo.addColorStop(.5,'rgba(255,55,190,.3)');halo.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,45,180,0)');
      context.fillStyle=halo;context.filter=`blur(${s.bloomBlur*diameter/s.bulletDiameter}px)`;context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*1.7,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
      context.filter='none';
      const tail=context.createLinearGradient(-radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio),0,0,0);
      tail.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,70,200,0)');tail.addColorStop(.65,'rgba(255,105,215,.6)');tail.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,210,245,.8)');
      context.fillStyle=tail;context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio),0);
      context.bezierCurveTo(-radius*1.3,-radius*.18,-radius*.9,-radius*.8,0,-radius*.65);
      context.lineTo(0,radius*.65);context.bezierCurveTo(-radius*.9,radius*.8,-radius*1.3,radius*.18,-radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio),0);context.fill();
      context.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
      const core=context.createRadialGradient(radius*.2,-radius*.2,1,0,0,radius);
      core.addColorStop(0,'#fff5ff');core.addColorStop(.4,'#ffb6ed');core.addColorStop(.8,'#ff62ce');core.addColorStop(1,'#d92b9c');
      context.fillStyle=core;context.shadowColor='#ff77da';context.shadowBlur=8;
      context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.restore();

}

import { luminousNovaSkillSettings as skill, damageRules } from './game-config.js';
import { totalCharacterATK } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { onEnemyDamage, getAllEnemies, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getLuminousNova, luminousNovaHits, drawLuminousPlasma } from './luminous-nova.js';

const buffKey='luminous-nova-ex';

/** Fixed banked-damage finisher; no second ATK or critical roll can exceed the explicit cap. */
export function luminousNovaFinisherDamage(damageDealt,player) {
  const baseAttack=damageRules.baseScale*totalCharacterATK(player)/100;
  return Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.round(damageDealt*skill.damageFraction),Math.floor(baseAttack*skill.attackCapMultiplier)));
}

/** Own the25s aura, temporary stats, accepted-damage bank and charged finishing shot. */
export function createLuminousNovaSkill() {
  let state=null;
  const image=new Image();image.src='../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Kei.png';const ready=image.decode();
  function removeBuff(){if(state?.owner.combatBuffs)delete state.owner.combatBuffs[buffKey];}
  function reset(){removeBuff();state=null;}
  const unsubscribe=onEnemyDamage(({source,damage})=>{
    if(state?.phase==='aura'&&source===state.owner&&Number.isFinite(damage))state.damageDealt+=Math.max(0,damage);
  });
  function cast(player,angle,getAngle=()=>angle) {
    reset();player.combatBuffs??={};
    player.combatBuffs[buffKey]={damageBonusMultiplier:skill.damageBonus,critPercent:skill.critBonus};
    state={owner:player,phase:'aura',elapsed:0,damageDealt:0,angle,getAngle,hits:new Set()};
  }
  /** Advance on simulation time only, so menus freeze both the buff and the charge. */
  function update(delta,player) {
    if(!state)return;
    if(state.owner!==player||!getLuminousNova(player)){reset();return;}
    let remaining=Math.max(0,delta);
    while(state&&remaining>1e-8) {
      const duration=state.phase==='aura'?skill.duration:state.phase==='opening'?skill.openingSeconds:
        state.phase==='charge'?skill.chargeSeconds:skill.projectileSeconds;
      const step=Math.min(remaining,Math.max(0,duration-state.elapsed));state.elapsed+=step;remaining-=step;
      if(state.phase==='opening'||state.phase==='charge')state.angle=state.getAngle();
      if(state.phase==='firing') {
        const from={x:state.x,y:state.y};state.x+=Math.cos(state.angle)*skill.projectileSpeed*step;state.y+=Math.sin(state.angle)*skill.projectileSpeed*step;
        for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
          if(state.hits.has(enemy.id)||!luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,state,skill.projectileDiameter/2))continue;
          state.hits.add(enemy.id);
          if(state.damage>0)damageEnemy(enemy.id,state.damage,state.owner,'normal',{canMiss:true});
        }
      }
      if(state.elapsed<duration-1e-8)break;
      if(state.phase==='aura') {
        removeBuff();state.damage=luminousNovaFinisherDamage(state.damageDealt,player);state.phase='opening';state.elapsed=0;
      } else if(state.phase==='opening'){state.phase='charge';state.elapsed=0;}
      else if(state.phase==='charge') {
        const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),distance=body.rx+skill.muzzleGap;
        state.x=body.x+Math.cos(state.angle)*distance;state.y=body.y+Math.sin(state.angle)*distance;
        state.phase='firing';state.elapsed=0;
      } else reset();
    }
  }
  /** Pink flame tongues and ground glow stay behind the player and never flash the whole screen. */

import { luminousNovaSkillSettings as skill, damageRules } from './game-config.js';
import { totalCharacterATK, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { onEnemyDamage, getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getLuminousNova, luminousNovaHits, drawLuminousPlasma } from './luminous-nova.js';

const buffKey='luminous-nova-ex';

/** Banked bonus only: no extra ATK or critical roll can exceed this component's cap. */
export function luminousNovaFinisherDamage(damageDealt,player) {
  const baseAttack=damageRules.baseScale*totalCharacterATK(player)/100;
  return Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.round(damageDealt*skill.damageFraction),Math.floor(baseAttack*skill.attackCapMultiplier)));
}

/** Acquire by remaining HP, excluding dead enemies and sprites outside the visible viewport. */
export function highestHpVisibleTarget(viewport,enemies=getAllEnemies()) {
  return enemies.filter(enemy=>enemy.hp>0&&(!viewport||(()=>{
    const radius=(enemy.spriteSize||89.6)/2;
    return enemy.x+radius>=viewport.x&&enemy.x-radius<=viewport.x+viewport.width&&
      enemy.y+radius>=viewport.y&&enemy.y-radius<=viewport.y+viewport.height;
  })())).reduce((best,enemy)=>!best||enemy.hp>best.hp?enemy:best,null);
}

/** Nominal281% ATK before the normal damage roll; the banked extra is calculated separately. */
export function luminousNovaFinisherBaseDamage(player) {
  return Math.max(0,Math.round(damageRules.baseScale*skill.finisherAttackMultiplier*totalCharacterATK(player)/100));
}

/** Own the25s aura, temporary stats, accepted-damage bank and charged finishing shot. */
export function createLuminousNovaSkill({random=Math.random}={}) {
  let state=null;
  const image=new Image();image.src='../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Kei.png';const ready=image.decode();
  function removeBuff(){if(state?.owner.combatBuffs)delete state.owner.combatBuffs[buffKey];}
  function reset(){removeBuff();state=null;}
  const unsubscribe=onEnemyDamage(({source,damage})=>{
    if(state?.phase==='aura'&&source===state.owner&&Number.isFinite(damage))state.damageDealt+=Math.max(0,damage);
  });
  function cast(player,angle,getAngle=()=>angle) {
    reset();player.combatBuffs??={};
    player.combatBuffs[buffKey]={damageBonusMultiplier:skill.damageBonus,critPercent:skill.critBonus};
    state={owner:player,phase:'aura',elapsed:0,damageDealt:0,angle,getAngle,hits:new Set()};
  }
  /** Advance on simulation time only, so menus freeze both the buff and the charge. */
  function update(delta,player,viewport) {
    if(!state)return;
    if(state.owner!==player||!getLuminousNova(player)){reset();return;}
    let remaining=Math.max(0,delta);
    while(state&&remaining>1e-8) {
      const duration=state.phase==='aura'?skill.duration:state.phase==='opening'?skill.openingSeconds:
        state.phase==='charge'?skill.chargeSeconds:skill.projectileSeconds;
      const step=Math.min(remaining,Math.max(0,duration-state.elapsed));state.elapsed+=step;remaining-=step;
      if(state.phase==='opening'||state.phase==='charge') {
        const target=highestHpVisibleTarget(viewport),body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
        const point=target?getCombatHitbox(target,true):null;
        state.angle=point?Math.atan2(point.y-body.y,point.x-body.x):state.getAngle();
      }
      if(state.phase==='firing'&&state.projectileActive) {
        const target=getEnemy(state.targetId);
        if(!target||target.hp<=0)state.projectileActive=false;
        else {
          const from={x:state.x,y:state.y},body=getCombatHitbox(target,true);
          state.angle=Math.atan2(body.y-state.y,body.x-state.x);
          const distance=Math.min(Math.hypot(body.x-state.x,body.y-state.y),skill.projectileSpeed*step);
          state.x+=Math.cos(state.angle)*distance;state.y+=Math.sin(state.angle)*distance;
          if(luminousNovaHits(target,from,state,skill.projectileDiameter/2)) {
            const baseHit=rollAttackDamage(state.owner,skill.finisherAttackMultiplier,random,{target});
            damageEnemy(target.id,baseHit.damage,state.owner,baseHit.type);
            if(state.damage>0&&getEnemy(target.id))damageEnemy(target.id,state.damage,state.owner,'normal');
            state.projectileActive=false;
          }
        }
      }
      if(state.phase==='firing'&&!state.projectileActive&&state.elapsed>=skill.returnSeconds){reset();break;}
      if(state.elapsed<duration-1e-8)break;
      if(state.phase==='aura') {
        removeBuff();state.damage=luminousNovaFinisherDamage(state.damageDealt,player);state.phase='opening';state.elapsed=0;
      } else if(state.phase==='opening'){state.phase='charge';state.elapsed=0;}
      else if(state.phase==='charge') {
        const target=highestHpVisibleTarget(viewport);
        const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),distance=body.rx+skill.muzzleGap;
        if(target){const point=getCombatHitbox(target,true);state.angle=Math.atan2(point.y-body.y,point.x-body.x);}
        state.targetId=target?.id;state.projectileActive=Boolean(target);state.launchAngle=state.angle;
        state.baseDamage=luminousNovaFinisherBaseDamage(player);
        state.x=body.x+Math.cos(state.angle)*distance;state.y=body.y+Math.sin(state.angle)*distance;
        state.phase='firing';state.elapsed=0;
      } else reset();
    }
  }
  /** Pink flame tongues and ground glow stay behind the player and never flash the whole screen. */
  function drawAura(context,camera) {
    if(!state||state.phase!=='aura')return;
    const player=state.owner,body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),size=player.spriteSize||89.6;
    context.save();context.translate(body.x-camera.x,body.y-camera.y);context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
    context.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,state.elapsed/.25,(skill.duration-state.elapsed)/.35));
    const glow=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,size*.2,0,0,size*.75);
    glow.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,75,195,0)');glow.addColorStop(.65,'rgba(255,85,205,.15)');glow.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,45,175,0)');
    context.fillStyle=glow;context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,size*.75,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
    context.shadowColor='#ff76dc';context.shadowBlur=12;
    for(let i=0;i<10;i++) {
      const angle=i/10*Math.PI*2+state.elapsed*.65,x=Math.cos(angle)*size*.43,y=Math.sin(angle)*size*.27+size*.2;
      const height=14+10*(.5+.5*Math.sin(state.elapsed*5+i*1.9));
      context.fillStyle='rgba(255,110,215,.42)';context.beginPath();context.moveTo(x-6,y);
      context.bezierCurveTo(x-10,y-height*.45,x+4,y-height*.65,x,y-height);
      context.bezierCurveTo(x+13,y-height*.3,x+8,y+5,x-6,y);context.fill();
    }
  hitCooldown:10/60, projectileSpeed:20*60,
  bulletDiameter:normalSpriteSize*sweeperSettings.sizeRatio,
  knockbackSeconds:15/60, knockbackSpeed:7*60, maxProjectiles:128,
  trailLengthRatio:1.2, bloomBlur:12
};

import { luminousNovaSettings, attackTimeFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';

/** Equip Kei's automatic weapon and its independent aura EX skill. */
export function createLuminousNovaWeapon() {
  return {id:'luminous-nova',name:'Luminous Nova',level:1,maxLevel:luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel,
    icon:'../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Kei.png',exSkill:true};
}
export function getLuminousNova(player) {return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon=>weapon?.id==='luminous-nova');}

/** Fire-rate bonuses are absolute multiples of the base cycle, never cumulative multipliers. */
export function luminousNovaLevelStats(player) {
  const level=Math.max(1,Math.min(7,getLuminousNova(player)?.level||1));
  const fireRate=1+Number(level>=3)+Number(level>=5)+Number(level>=7);
  return {level,fireRate,interval:luminousNovaSettings.attackInterval/fireRate,
    damageMultiplier:(level>=2?1.2:1)*(level>=4?1.3:1),knockback:level>=6};
}

/** Damage levels multiply base damage; flat enhancements split over the base-cycle projectile count. */
export function rollLuminousNovaDamage(player,random=Math.random,target) {
  const stats=luminousNovaLevelStats(player);
  return rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'luminous-nova',luminousNovaSettings.damageMultiplier,
    [(stats.damageMultiplier-1)*100],{projectileCount:stats.fireRate,hitCooldownFrames:10}),random,{target});
}

/** Sweep the spherical head so fast plasma rounds cannot tunnel past enemies. */
export function luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,to,radius=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter/2) {
  const body=getCombatHitbox(enemy,true);
  return segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+radius,ry:body.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,to.x,to.y);
}

/** Independent random-target, unlimited-piercing automatic plasma weapon. */
export function createLuminousNovaAttack({random=Math.random}={}) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings;
  let owner=null,cooldown=0,bullets=[],enabled=true,shots=0,skillFinishing=false;
  function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;bullets=[];shots=0;}
  function fire(player) {
    const enemies=getAllEnemies();if(!enemies.length)return false;
    const target=enemies[Math.min(enemies.length-1,Math.floor(random()*enemies.length))];
    const origin=getCombatHitbox(player,false),body=getCombatHitbox(target,true);
    const angle=Math.atan2(body.y-origin.y,body.x-origin.x);
    if(bullets.length<s.maxProjectiles){bullets.push({x:origin.x,y:origin.y,angle,age:0,hits:new Map()});shots++;}
    return true;
  }
  /** Move and expire each shot independently; pierce all targets with a per-shot hit cooldown. */
  function advance(delta,player) {
    for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
      const bullet=bullets[i],step=Math.min(delta,s.duration-bullet.age),from={x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y};
      bullet.age+=step;bullet.x+=Math.cos(bullet.angle)*s.projectileSpeed*step;bullet.y+=Math.sin(bullet.angle)*s.projectileSpeed*step;
      for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
        if(bullet.age-(bullet.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<s.hitCooldown-1e-8||!luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,bullet))continue;
        bullet.hits.set(enemy.id,bullet.age); // A missed hit cannot retry every frame.
        const hit=rollLuminousNovaDamage(player,random,enemy);
        const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true});
        const living=getEnemy(enemy.id);
        if(landed!==false&&living&&luminousNovaLevelStats(player).knockback) {
          const distance=s.knockbackSpeed*s.knockbackSeconds;
          applySkillControl(living,Math.cos(bullet.angle)*distance,Math.sin(bullet.angle)*distance,
            s.knockbackSeconds,s.knockbackSeconds);
        }
      }
      if(bullet.age>=s.duration-1e-8)bullets.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
  /** Stagger shots over the2.5s base cycle; Haste changes cadence, not lifetime or hit cooldown. */
  function update(delta,player) {
    if(!getLuminousNova(player)){reset();return;}
    if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    if(!enabled||delta<=0)return;
    if(skillFinishing){advance(delta,player);return;}
    let remaining=delta;
    while(remaining>1e-8) {
      if(cooldown<=1e-8) {
        if(!fire(player)){advance(remaining,player);return;}
        cooldown=attackTimeFormula(luminousNovaLevelStats(player).interval,ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);
      }
      const step=Math.min(remaining,cooldown,s.hitCooldown/2);
      advance(step,player);cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);remaining-=step;
    }
  }
  /** Draw every active pink round using the shared spherical plasma renderer. */
  function draw(context,camera) {for(const bullet of bullets)drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet);}
  return {ready:Promise.resolve(),reset,update,draw,
    setSkillFinishing(value){skillFinishing=Boolean(value);},
    setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);if(!enabled)bullets=[];},
    get projectileCount(){return bullets.length;},get shotsFired(){return shots;}};
}

  /** Stagger shots over the2.5s base cycle; Haste changes cadence, not lifetime or hit cooldown. */
  function update(delta,player) {
    if(!getLuminousNova(player)){reset();return;}
    if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    if(!enabled||delta<=0)return;
    if(skillFinishing){advance(delta,player);return;}
    let remaining=delta;
    while(remaining>1e-8) {
      if(cooldown<=1e-8) {
        if(!fire(player)){advance(remaining,player);return;}
        cooldown=attackTimeFormula(luminousNovaLevelStats(player).interval,ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);
      }
      const step=Math.min(remaining,cooldown,s.hitCooldown/2);
      advance(step,player);cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);remaining-=step;
    }
  }

/** Shared spherical plasma rendering; the EX changes diameter without changing the normal weapon. */
export function drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,diameter=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter,duration=luminousNovaSettings.duration) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings,radius=diameter/2;
  context.save();context.translate(bullet.x-camera.x,bullet.y-camera.y);context.rotate(bullet.angle);
  context.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,(duration-bullet.age)/.06);
  context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  const halo=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,radius*.2,0,0,radius*1.7);
  halo.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,155,235,.55)');halo.addColorStop(.5,'rgba(255,55,190,.3)');halo.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,45,180,0)');

/** Shared spherical plasma rendering; the EX changes diameter without changing the normal weapon. */
export function drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,diameter=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter,duration=luminousNovaSettings.duration) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings,radius=diameter/2;
  context.save();context.translate(bullet.x-camera.x,bullet.y-camera.y);context.rotate(bullet.angle);
  context.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,(duration-bullet.age)/.06);
  context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  const halo=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,radius*.2,0,0,radius*1.7);
  halo.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,155,235,.55)');halo.addColorStop(.5,'rgba(255,55,190,.3)');halo.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,45,180,0)');
  const effectScale=diameter/(s.bulletDiameter/.2);
  context.fillStyle=halo;context.filter=`blur(${s.bloomBlur*effectScale}px)`;context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*1.7,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
  context.filter='none';
  const tail=context.createLinearGradient(-radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio),0,0,0);
  tail.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,70,200,0)');tail.addColorStop(.65,'rgba(255,105,215,.6)');tail.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,210,245,.8)');
  context.fillStyle=tail;context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio),0);
  context.bezierCurveTo(-radius*1.3,-radius*.18,-radius*.9,-radius*.8,0,-radius*.65);
  context.lineTo(0,radius*.65);context.bezierCurveTo(-radius*.9,radius*.8,-radius*1.3,radius*.18,-radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio),0);context.fill();
  context.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
  const core=context.createRadialGradient(radius*.2,-radius*.2,1,0,0,radius);
  core.addColorStop(0,'#fff5ff');core.addColorStop(.4,'#ffb6ed');core.addColorStop(.8,'#ff62ce');core.addColorStop(1,'#d92b9c');
  context.fillStyle=core;context.shadowColor='#ff77da';context.shadowBlur=8*effectScale;
  context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.restore();

}

/** Shared spherical plasma rendering; the EX changes diameter without changing the normal weapon. */
export function drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,diameter=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter,duration=luminousNovaSettings.duration) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings,radius=diameter/2;
  context.save();context.translate(bullet.x-camera.x,bullet.y-camera.y);context.rotate(bullet.angle);
  context.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,(duration-bullet.age)/.06);
  context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  const effectScale=diameter/(s.bulletDiameter/.2);
  // A broad soft halo and a tighter luminous rim keep small shots bright without enlarging their core.
  const halo=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius*2.8);
  halo.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,205,248,.8)');halo.addColorStop(.25,'rgba(255,115,222,.55)');
  halo.addColorStop(.55,'rgba(244,48,186,.22)');halo.addColorStop(1,'rgba(220,35,180,0)');
  context.fillStyle=halo;context.filter=`blur(${Math.max(2,s.bloomBlur*effectScale)}px)`;
  context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*2.8,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
  context.filter='none';
  const rim=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,radius*.5,0,0,radius*1.6);
  rim.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,224,252,.7)');rim.addColorStop(.45,'rgba(255,99,216,.4)');rim.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,55,196,0)');
  context.fillStyle=rim;context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*1.6,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
  const tail=context.createLinearGradient(-radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio),0,0,0);
  tail.addColorStop(0,'rgba(219,45,183,0)');tail.addColorStop(.25,'rgba(239,61,194,.12)');
  tail.addColorStop(.55,'rgba(255,105,219,.45)');tail.addColorStop(.8,'rgba(255,175,239,.75)');tail.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,239,253,.9)');
  context.fillStyle=tail;context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio),0);
  context.bezierCurveTo(-radius*1.3,-radius*.18,-radius*.9,-radius*.8,0,-radius*.65);
  context.lineTo(0,radius*.65);context.bezierCurveTo(-radius*.9,radius*.8,-radius*1.3,radius*.18,-radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio),0);context.fill();
  context.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
  // Off-center white highlight rolls smoothly through pale pink into a saturated magenta edge.
  const core=context.createRadialGradient(radius*.18,-radius*.18,0,0,0,radius);
  core.addColorStop(0,'#ffffff');core.addColorStop(.2,'#fff2fe');core.addColorStop(.45,'#ffc6f4');
  core.addColorStop(.7,'#ff83de');core.addColorStop(.9,'#f44fc4');core.addColorStop(1,'#d82bac');
  context.fillStyle=core;context.shadowColor='#ff8fe4';context.shadowBlur=Math.max(3,12*effectScale);
  context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.restore();

}
export const luminousNovaSettings = {
  maxLevel:7, damageMultiplier:1.4, attackInterval:150/60, duration:45/60,

/** Shared spherical plasma rendering; the EX changes diameter without changing the normal weapon. */
export function drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,diameter=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter,duration=luminousNovaSettings.duration) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings,radius=diameter/2;
  context.save();context.translate(bullet.x-camera.x,bullet.y-camera.y);context.rotate(bullet.angle);
  context.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,(duration-bullet.age)/.06);
  context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  const effectScale=diameter/(s.bulletDiameter/.2);
  // A broad soft halo and a tighter luminous rim keep small shots bright without enlarging their core.
  const halo=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius*3.6);
  halo.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,225,252,.95)');halo.addColorStop(.25,'rgba(255,125,229,.75)');
  halo.addColorStop(.55,'rgba(244,48,186,.35)');halo.addColorStop(1,'rgba(220,35,180,0)');
  context.fillStyle=halo;context.filter=`blur(${Math.max(3,s.bloomBlur*effectScale)}px)`;
  context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*3.6,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
  context.filter='none';
  const rim=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,radius*.5,0,0,radius*1.6);
  rim.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,224,252,.7)');rim.addColorStop(.45,'rgba(255,99,216,.4)');rim.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,55,196,0)');
  context.fillStyle=rim;context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*1.6,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
  const trailLength=radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio);
  const tail=context.createLinearGradient(-trailLength,0,0,0);
  tail.addColorStop(0,'rgba(239,61,194,0)');tail.addColorStop(.15,'rgba(255,80,210,.35)');
  tail.addColorStop(.45,'rgba(255,130,230,.75)');tail.addColorStop(.75,'rgba(255,200,248,.95)');tail.addColorStop(1,'#fff5ff');
  /** Draw a connected tapered wake behind the spherical head, with a narrow luminous spine. */
  function drawTrail(width) {
    context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-trailLength,0);
    context.bezierCurveTo(-trailLength*.65,-radius*width*.2,-radius*1.4,-radius*width,0,-radius*width);
    context.lineTo(0,radius*width);
    context.bezierCurveTo(-radius*1.4,radius*width,-trailLength*.65,radius*width*.2,-trailLength,0);context.fill();
  }
  context.fillStyle=tail;context.filter=`blur(${Math.max(2,radius*.65)}px)`;drawTrail(1.15);
  context.filter='none';drawTrail(.7);
  // A second thin pass reads as hot plasma rather than a translucent flat tail.
  drawTrail(.22);
  context.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
  // Off-center white highlight rolls smoothly through pale pink into a saturated magenta edge.
  const core=context.createRadialGradient(radius*.18,-radius*.18,0,0,0,radius);
  core.addColorStop(0,'#ffffff');core.addColorStop(.2,'#fff2fe');core.addColorStop(.45,'#ffc6f4');
  core.addColorStop(.7,'#ff83de');core.addColorStop(.9,'#f44fc4');core.addColorStop(1,'#d82bac');
  context.fillStyle=core;context.shadowColor='#ff8fe4';context.shadowBlur=Math.max(6,22*effectScale);
  context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.restore();

}

export function drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,diameter=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter,duration=luminousNovaSettings.duration) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings,radius=diameter/2;
  context.save();context.translate(bullet.x-camera.x,bullet.y-camera.y);context.rotate(bullet.angle);
  const fade=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(duration-bullet.age)/.06));
  context.globalAlpha=fade;
  context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  const effectScale=diameter/(s.bulletDiameter/.2);
  // Reconstruct recent positions along the fixed flight path. Dense blurred samples
  // fade and contract with age, blending into a receding light wake instead of separate dots.
  const echoSeconds=.14,echoCount=24;
  const echo=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius*1.8);
  echo.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,225,253,.8)');echo.addColorStop(.35,'rgba(255,140,230,.5)');
  echo.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,65,200,0)');
  context.fillStyle=echo;context.filter=`blur(${Math.max(3,radius*.9)}px)`;
  for(let i=echoCount;i>=1;i--) {
    const age=echoSeconds*i/echoCount;
    if(age>bullet.age)continue;
    const strength=1-age/echoSeconds;
    context.globalAlpha=fade*.22*strength*strength;
    context.save();context.translate(-s.projectileSpeed*age,0);
    context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*(.65+strength*1.15),0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.restore();
  }
  context.globalAlpha=fade;
  // A broad soft halo and a tighter luminous rim keep small shots bright without enlarging their core.
  const halo=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius*3.6);
  halo.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,225,252,.95)');halo.addColorStop(.25,'rgba(255,125,229,.75)');
  halo.addColorStop(.55,'rgba(244,48,186,.35)');halo.addColorStop(1,'rgba(220,35,180,0)');
  context.fillStyle=halo;context.filter=`blur(${Math.max(3,s.bloomBlur*effectScale)}px)`;
  context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*3.6,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
  context.filter='none';
  const rim=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,radius*.5,0,0,radius*1.6);
  rim.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,224,252,.7)');rim.addColorStop(.45,'rgba(255,99,216,.4)');rim.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,55,196,0)');
  context.fillStyle=rim;context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*1.6,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
  const trailLength=radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio);
  const tail=context.createLinearGradient(-trailLength,0,0,0);
  tail.addColorStop(0,'rgba(239,61,194,0)');tail.addColorStop(.15,'rgba(255,80,210,.35)');
  tail.addColorStop(.45,'rgba(255,130,230,.75)');tail.addColorStop(.75,'rgba(255,200,248,.95)');tail.addColorStop(1,'#fff5ff');
  /** Draw a connected tapered wake behind the spherical head, with a narrow luminous spine. */
  function drawTrail(width) {
    context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-trailLength,0);
    context.bezierCurveTo(-trailLength*.65,-radius*width*.2,-radius*1.4,-radius*width,0,-radius*width);
    context.lineTo(0,radius*width);
    context.bezierCurveTo(-radius*1.4,radius*width,-trailLength*.65,radius*width*.2,-trailLength,0);context.fill();
  }
  // Wide additive bloom underneath the bright tail makes its fading gradient feel emissive.
  context.fillStyle=tail;context.globalAlpha=fade*.65;
  context.filter=`blur(${Math.max(5,radius*1.7)}px)`;drawTrail(2.2);
  context.globalAlpha=fade;
  context.filter=`blur(${Math.max(2,radius*.65)}px)`;drawTrail(1.15);
  context.filter='none';drawTrail(.7);
  // A second thin pass reads as hot plasma rather than a translucent flat tail.
  drawTrail(.22);
  context.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
  // Off-center white highlight rolls smoothly through pale pink into a saturated magenta edge.
  const core=context.createRadialGradient(radius*.18,-radius*.18,0,0,0,radius);
  core.addColorStop(0,'#ffffff');core.addColorStop(.2,'#fff2fe');core.addColorStop(.45,'#ffc6f4');
  core.addColorStop(.7,'#ff83de');core.addColorStop(.9,'#f44fc4');core.addColorStop(1,'#d82bac');
  context.fillStyle=core;context.shadowColor='#ff8fe4';context.shadowBlur=Math.max(6,22*effectScale);
  context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.restore();

}

import { luminousNovaSettings, attackTimeFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';

/** Equip Kei's automatic weapon and its independent aura EX skill. */
export function createLuminousNovaWeapon() {
  return {id:'luminous-nova',name:'Luminous Nova',level:1,maxLevel:luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel,
    icon:'../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Kei.png',iconRotation:-45,exSkill:true};
}
export function getLuminousNova(player) {return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon=>weapon?.id==='luminous-nova');}

/** Fire-rate bonuses are absolute multiples of the base cycle, never cumulative multipliers. */
export function luminousNovaLevelStats(player) {
  const level=Math.max(1,Math.min(7,getLuminousNova(player)?.level||1));
  const fireRate=1+Number(level>=3)+Number(level>=5)+Number(level>=7);
  return {level,fireRate,interval:luminousNovaSettings.attackInterval/fireRate,
    damageMultiplier:(level>=2?1.2:1)*(level>=4?1.3:1),knockback:level>=6};
}

/** Damage levels multiply base damage; flat enhancements split over the base-cycle projectile count. */
export function rollLuminousNovaDamage(player,random=Math.random,target) {
  const stats=luminousNovaLevelStats(player);
  return rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'luminous-nova',luminousNovaSettings.damageMultiplier,
    [(stats.damageMultiplier-1)*100],{projectileCount:stats.fireRate,hitCooldownFrames:10}),random,{target});
}

/** Sweep the spherical head so fast plasma rounds cannot tunnel past enemies. */
export function luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,to,radius=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter/2) {
  const body=getCombatHitbox(enemy,true);
  return segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+radius,ry:body.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,to.x,to.y);
}

/** Independent random-target, unlimited-piercing automatic plasma weapon. */
export function createLuminousNovaAttack({random=Math.random}={}) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings;
  let owner=null,cooldown=0,bullets=[],enabled=true,shots=0,skillFinishing=false;
  function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;bullets=[];shots=0;}
  function fire(player,aim) {
    const origin=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
    // Follow the shared arrow/crosshair aim and keep that direction throughout this shot.
    const angle=Number.isFinite(aim)?aim:0;
    if(bullets.length<s.maxProjectiles){bullets.push({x:origin.x,y:origin.y,angle,age:0,hits:new Map()});shots++;}
    return true;
  }
  /** Move and expire each shot independently; pierce all targets with a per-shot hit cooldown. */
  function advance(delta,player) {
    for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
      const bullet=bullets[i],step=Math.min(delta,s.duration-bullet.age),from={x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y};
      bullet.age+=step;bullet.x+=Math.cos(bullet.angle)*s.projectileSpeed*step;bullet.y+=Math.sin(bullet.angle)*s.projectileSpeed*step;
      for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
        if(bullet.age-(bullet.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<s.hitCooldown-1e-8||!luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,bullet))continue;
        bullet.hits.set(enemy.id,bullet.age); // A missed hit cannot retry every frame.
        const hit=rollLuminousNovaDamage(player,random,enemy);
        const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true});
        const living=getEnemy(enemy.id);
        if(landed!==false&&living&&luminousNovaLevelStats(player).knockback) {
          const distance=s.knockbackSpeed*s.knockbackSeconds;
          applySkillControl(living,Math.cos(bullet.angle)*distance,Math.sin(bullet.angle)*distance,
            s.knockbackSeconds,s.knockbackSeconds);
        }
      }
      if(bullet.age>=s.duration-1e-8)bullets.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
  /** Stagger shots over the2.5s base cycle; Haste changes cadence, not lifetime or hit cooldown. */
  function update(delta,player,aim=0) {
    if(!getLuminousNova(player)){reset();return;}
    if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    if(!enabled||delta<=0)return;
    if(skillFinishing){advance(delta,player);return;}
    let remaining=delta;
    while(remaining>1e-8) {
      if(cooldown<=1e-8) {
        fire(player,aim);
        cooldown=attackTimeFormula(luminousNovaLevelStats(player).interval,ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);
      }
      const step=Math.min(remaining,cooldown,s.hitCooldown/2);
      advance(step,player);cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);remaining-=step;
    }
  }
  /** Draw every active pink round using the shared spherical plasma renderer. */
  function draw(context,camera) {for(const bullet of bullets)drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet);}
  return {ready:Promise.resolve(),reset,update,draw,
    setSkillFinishing(value){skillFinishing=Boolean(value);},
    setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);if(!enabled)bullets=[];},

  function drawTrail(width) {
    context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-trailLength,0);
    context.bezierCurveTo(-trailLength*.65,-radius*width*.2,-radius*1.4,-radius*width,0,-radius*width);
    context.lineTo(0,radius*width);
    context.bezierCurveTo(-radius*1.4,radius*width,-trailLength*.65,radius*width*.2,-trailLength,0);context.fill();
  }
  // Wide additive bloom underneath the bright tail makes its fading gradient feel emissive.
  context.fillStyle=tail;context.globalAlpha=fade*.65;
  context.filter=`blur(${Math.max(5,radius*1.7)}px)`;drawTrail(2.2);
  context.globalAlpha=fade;
  context.filter=`blur(${Math.max(2,radius*.65)}px)`;drawTrail(1.15);

  /** Stagger shots over the2.5s base cycle; Haste changes cadence, not lifetime or hit cooldown. */
  function update(delta,player,aim=0) {
    if(!getLuminousNova(player)){reset();return;}
    if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    if(!enabled||delta<=0)return;
    if(skillFinishing){advance(delta,player);return;}
    let remaining=delta;
    while(remaining>1e-8) {
      if(cooldown<=1e-8) {
        fire(player,aim);
        cooldown=attackTimeFormula(luminousNovaLevelStats(player).interval,ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);
      }
      const step=Math.min(remaining,cooldown,s.hitCooldown/2);
      advance(step,player);cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);remaining-=step;
    }
  }

/** Shared spherical plasma rendering; the EX changes diameter without changing the normal weapon. */
export function drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,diameter=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter,duration=luminousNovaSettings.duration) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings,radius=diameter/2;
  context.save();context.translate(bullet.x-camera.x,bullet.y-camera.y);context.rotate(bullet.angle);
  const fade=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(duration-bullet.age)/.06))*Math.min(1,bullet.age/s.fadeInSeconds);
  // Only leave a wake along positions reached after acceleration, never behind the muzzle.
  const wakeAge=bullet.accelerating?Math.max(0,bullet.age-s.accelerationSeconds):bullet.age;
  context.globalAlpha=fade;
  context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  const effectScale=diameter/(s.bulletDiameter/.14);
  // Reconstruct recent positions along the fixed flight path. Dense blurred samples
  // fade and contract with age, blending into a receding light wake instead of separate dots.
  const echo=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius*1.8);
  echo.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,225,253,.8)');echo.addColorStop(.35,'rgba(255,140,230,.5)');
  echo.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,65,200,0)');
  /** Sample a fading wake; the older, longer layer contracts fully into its trailing tip. */
  function drawAfterimages(count,seconds,opacity,shrink) {
    context.fillStyle=echo;context.filter=`blur(${Math.max(3,radius*.9)}px)`;
    for(let i=count;i>=1;i--) {
      const age=seconds*i/count;
      if(age>wakeAge)continue;
      const strength=1-age/seconds;
      if(strength<=0)continue;
      context.globalAlpha=fade*opacity*strength*strength;
      context.save();context.translate(-s.projectileSpeed*age,0);
      const size=shrink?1.8*Math.pow(strength,.7):.65+strength*1.15;
      context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*size,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.restore();
    }
  }
  // The lingering layer reaches twice as far as the primary afterimage history.
  drawAfterimages(s.lingeringAfterimageCount,s.lingeringAfterimageSeconds,.12,true);
  drawAfterimages(s.afterimageCount,s.afterimageSeconds,.14,false);
  context.globalAlpha=fade;
  // A broad soft halo and a tighter luminous rim keep small shots bright without enlarging their core.
  const halo=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius*3.6);
  halo.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,225,252,.95)');halo.addColorStop(.25,'rgba(255,125,229,.75)');
  halo.addColorStop(.55,'rgba(244,48,186,.35)');halo.addColorStop(1,'rgba(220,35,180,0)');
  context.fillStyle=halo;context.filter=`blur(${Math.max(3,s.bloomBlur*effectScale)}px)`;
  context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*3.6,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
  context.filter='none';
  const rim=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,radius*.5,0,0,radius*1.6);
  rim.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,224,252,.7)');rim.addColorStop(.45,'rgba(255,99,216,.4)');rim.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,55,196,0)');
  context.fillStyle=rim;context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*1.6,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
  const trailLength=Math.min(radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio),s.projectileSpeed*wakeAge);
  const tail=context.createLinearGradient(-trailLength,0,0,0);
  tail.addColorStop(0,'rgba(239,61,194,0)');tail.addColorStop(.15,'rgba(255,80,210,.35)');
  tail.addColorStop(.45,'rgba(255,130,230,.75)');tail.addColorStop(.75,'rgba(255,200,248,.95)');tail.addColorStop(1,'#fff5ff');
  /** Draw a connected tapered wake behind the spherical head, with a narrow luminous spine. */
  function drawTrail(width) {
    context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-trailLength,0);
    context.bezierCurveTo(-trailLength*.65,-radius*width*.2,-radius*1.4,-radius*width,0,-radius*width);
    context.lineTo(0,radius*width);
    context.bezierCurveTo(-radius*1.4,radius*width,-trailLength*.65,radius*width*.2,-trailLength,0);context.fill();
  }
  // Wide additive bloom underneath the bright tail makes its fading gradient feel emissive.
  context.fillStyle=tail;context.globalAlpha=fade*.65;
  context.filter=`blur(${Math.max(5,radius*1.7)}px)`;drawTrail(2.2);
  context.globalAlpha=fade;
  context.filter=`blur(${Math.max(2,radius*.65)}px)`;drawTrail(1.15);
  context.filter='none';drawTrail(.7);
  // A second thin pass reads as hot plasma rather than a translucent flat tail.
  drawTrail(.22);
  // Pure additive light fades to transparency: no opaque sphere, colored rim or hard outline.
  const light=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius*2);
  light.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,250,255,.95)');
  light.addColorStop(.2,'rgba(255,235,252,.8)');
  light.addColorStop(.45,'rgba(255,185,239,.45)');
  light.addColorStop(.7,'rgba(255,125,220,.15)');
  light.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,100,210,0)');
  context.fillStyle=light;context.filter=`blur(${Math.max(2,radius*.45)}px)`;
  context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.restore();

}

  // Automatic projectile size: 14% of the original (20% reduced by another 30%).
  bulletDiameter:normalSpriteSize*sweeperSettings.sizeRatio*.14,

  knockbackSeconds:15/60, knockbackSpeed:7*60, maxProjectiles:128,

/** Draw animation poses with a short blend when entering/leaving boss actions. */
function drawCharacter(character) {
  if (character.death && character.lastPose && !character.animationFrames) {
    drawPose(character, character.lastPose, 1);
    drawCharacterOcclusion(character);
    return;
  }
  if (character.animationFrames) {
    const frames=character.actionAnimations?.[character.bossAction?.clip] || character.animationFrames;
    const frame = frames[gifFrameAt(frames, character.bossAction?.clip ? (character.bossAction.elapsed||0)*1000 : character.gifElapsed || 0)];
    const image = frame.image;
    drawPose({ ...character, image }, {
      crop: { x: 0, y: 0, width: image.naturalWidth, height: image.naturalHeight, footY: image.naturalHeight },
      mirrored: character.facing !== (character.nativeFacing || 'left')
    }, 1);
    drawCharacterOcclusion(character);
    return;
  }
  const pose = {
    crop: getFrameRectangle(character, getAnimationFrame(character)),
    mirrored: character.mirroredDirections?.includes(character.direction)
  };
  const transition = character.transition;
  if (transition) {
    const progress = Math.min(1, transition.elapsed / character.transitionDuration);
    drawPose(character, transition.from, 1 - progress);
    drawPose(character, pose, progress);
    if (progress === 1) character.transition = null;
  } else {
    drawPose(character, pose, 1);
  }
  character.lastPose = pose;
  drawCharacterOcclusion(character);
}

  context.globalAlpha=fade;

  const echo=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius*1.8);
  echo.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,225,253,.8)');echo.addColorStop(.35,'rgba(255,140,230,.5)');
  echo.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,65,200,0)');
  /** Sample a fading wake; the older, longer layer contracts fully into its trailing tip. */
  function drawAfterimages(count,seconds,opacity,shrink) {
    // Gradient transparency supplies softness without a costly filtered canvas pass per sample.
    context.fillStyle=echo;
    for(let i=count;i>=1;i--) {
